furnishingSuggestions.title: Relaxed lounge
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a cream sofa, a walnut coffee table, a large woven rug and a reading lamp. Keep the room geometry, windows and doors unchanged.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Work and unwind
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a small writing desk, an upholstered reading chair, a bookcase and a warm floor lamp. Keep existing openings and the camera view.

title: Bedroom
suggestions: Soft blue walls + light oak floor
Warm white walls + natural oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Calm bedroom
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Refresh the bedding with warm white linen, add simple oak bedside tables and soft lamps. Keep the bed location and all room openings.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Cosy retreat
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a textured headboard, layered neutral bedding, a small reading chair and warm lighting. Preserve the room layout and windows.

title: Empty apartment
suggestions: Warm white walls + natural oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Living + dining
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Furnish the empty area with a compact cream sofa, a low coffee table, a woven rug and a small round dining table. Keep the kitchen, room geometry and openings unchanged.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Home office lounge
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Add a compact desk, an ergonomic chair, a bookcase and a small lounge chair with a floor lamp. Keep all kitchen cabinetry, windows and doors unchanged.

title: Sunlit kitchen
suggestions: Warm white walls + light oak floor
Muted olive walls + pale oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Warm natural kitchen
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try oak counter stools, a washable runner, a ceramic fruit bowl and a small plant. Keep all cabinets, appliances, countertops, windows and plumbing locations unchanged.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Colourful kitchen
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try colourful counter stools, a patterned runner and a few cheerful countertop accessories. Preserve the kitchen layout, appliances and window.

title: Bright bathroom
suggestions: Warm white walls + pale oak floor
Soft sage walls + natural oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Quiet spa
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a plain linen shower curtain, neatly folded cream towels and minimal bath accessories. Keep the tub, shower fixtures, tile, plumbing locations and room geometry unchanged.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Playful bath
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a softly patterned shower curtain and coordinated blue towels and bath accessories. Keep all fixed bathroom fittings, tile and the room layout.

title: Calm bedroom
suggestions: Warm white walls + light oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Soft modern bedroom
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try crisp white bedding, a rust-coloured throw, simple oak bedside tables and warm bedside lamps. Keep the bed position, windows, doors and room geometry.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Layered retreat
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try layered neutral bedding, a textured wool rug and soft bedside lighting. Keep the headboard, openings and camera view unchanged.

title: Forest-view dining
suggestions: Warm white walls + natural oak floor
Soft sage walls + light oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Natural dining
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a light oak dining table, woven-seat chairs, a textured rug and simple ceramic tableware. Keep the windows, doors and the view unchanged.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Colourful gathering
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try colourful upholstered dining chairs, a warm wood table, a patterned rug and restrained table decorations. Keep the room geometry, windows and doors unchanged.

title: Artist studio
suggestions: Warm white walls + natural oak floor
Muted blue walls + light oak floor

furnishingSuggestions.title: Creative workspace
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a simple oak worktable, a comfortable task chair, low open shelves and warm task lighting. Retain the easel, windows, doors and room geometry.

furnishingSuggestions.title: Reading and making
furnishingSuggestions.brief: Try a cosy reading chair, a low bookcase, a woven rug and a floor lamp beside the creative workspace. Keep the easel, windows and doors unchanged.
